author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a child with a large ring head, torso leaning toward a small ball at the left, front arm reaching toward it, back arm swinging, legs mid-stride; reads as a child playing ball. The first candidate (r4 head) was nearly identical to the rejected drawing; the child's large head (r6) was chosen to match the reference's proportions.
omissions: The reference's filled body silhouette is reduced to a stick figure; head-to-neck gap is exactly 8 on centerlines (vertical, certified).
drawing_plan: SQUARE: head r6 at (27,12); neck (27,26); torso bezier to hips (22,34); front arm to (19,26); back arm (35,32)-(42,32); legs to (16,42) and (29,38)-(29,42); ball r3 at (9,32).
lucide_reference: No Lucide match; pose from full_body_ref.png and the approved football-player-approaching-ball construction.
